note: Illinois DNR park near Colchester, 7 mi west of Macomb, around 93-acre Argyle Lake. Twisted Oak (86 Class A sites) sits on a wooded ridge between two arms of the lake; Big Oaks (24 electric-only and 18 Class C sites) is east of the dam and Twin Oaks (31 primitive) across the water. The shower house is open May 1 - November 1. A separate equestrian campground lies about 1 km west. --Claude
